title: On Loneliness

I feel but I can not express

I talk, but then I hurt

I stay silent, but now I am hurt

What is real and what is not real is no longer clear

I am in the middle of people, yet I am in the middle of nowhere

I spot a stranger from far...finally a person who knows...only to realize they were waiting for others to join them...

I try to write, but then to whom? 

Screaming the void time and time again, just to realize the voice wouldn't propagate.
.............
